restaurantName: Ding Te Le Zhou Mian Guan
address: No 22, Lane 494, Middle Huaihai Road, Huangpu, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: To the passer-by, this simple shop hidden in an alley on Huaihai Road looks pretty much like any other. What sets it apart, however, are the authentic noodles it serves. It is particularly famous for its shredded pork noodles with scallions, its yellow croaker noodles with pickled vegetables, and its deep-fried pork chops. You can also enjoy congee, rice and snacks – and it stays open 24 hours a day....
pageTitle: Ding Te Le Zhou Mian Guan
